catalog.title: Flagship Brand Experience
catalog.summary: A complete conversion-focused brand website with a live booking-request flow and a distinct visual identity.
catalog.requirement: 6+ useful sections; 3 fixed experiences; detail views; validated date/party booking; persistent demo request; responsive, accessible design

catalog.title: Interactive Editorial Investigation
catalog.summary: A long-form, data-led magazine feature with interactive charts, scrollytelling and evidence notes.
catalog.requirement: 800–1,100 word feature; fixed six-district dataset; 3 data visualisations; linked interactions; accessible table; honest methodology

catalog.title: Commerce and Booking Marketplace
catalog.summary: A local-first rental marketplace with searchable inventory, date-aware cart calculations and a complete demo booking flow.
catalog.requirement: 12 fixed products; composable search/filters; date and stock validation; editable cart; demo checkout; persistent state

catalog.title: Operations Command Centre
catalog.summary: A working logistics operations dashboard with linked metrics, drill-downs, alerts and a simulated event feed.
catalog.requirement: 24+ seeded records; reconciled KPIs; 3 linked charts; composable filters; detail actions; deterministic simulation; CSV export

catalog.title: Project Operations Workspace
catalog.summary: A local-first multi-view project planner with synchronized Kanban, table and calendar views.
catalog.requirement: 3 projects and 15+ tasks; CRUD; synchronized views; drag/keyboard status changes; composable filters; activity history; JSON round-trip

catalog.title: 2D Puzzle Game
catalog.summary: An original 2D puzzle game with a clear central mechanic, solvable challenges and satisfying feedback.
catalog.requirement: Original puzzle mechanic; multiple solvable levels; readable rules and state; undo/restart; keyboard/touch; progress save

catalog.title: 3D Exploration Game
catalog.summary: An original interactive 3D game world with exploration, meaningful interaction and a clear player objective.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D environment; responsive player/camera controls; meaningful world interaction; objective and progression; keyboard/touch; resize and rendering fallback

catalog.title: Living Systems Simulator
catalog.summary: A deterministic ecosystem simulation with specified coupled equations, scenarios, plots and CSV history export.
catalog.requirement: 4 coupled state variables; correct equations; fixed-step RK4; 3 scenarios; 5 live plots; deterministic controls; CSV export

catalog.title: Poster Foundry — Creative Production Studio
catalog.summary: A real browser-based vector poster editor with editable layers, transforms, undo/redo and export.
catalog.requirement: Editable text and 4+ shapes; synchronized layers; transform/style controls; undo/redo; save/import/export; valid SVG and PNG

catalog.title: Pulse Loom — Browser Music Workstation
catalog.summary: A multi-voice Web Audio step sequencer with musical controls, persistent patterns and WAV export.
catalog.requirement: 4 distinct synth voices; 16-step sequencer; tempo/swing/scales; mute/solo; drift-free clock; JSON round-trip; valid WAV export

catalog.title: 3D Colony Builder
catalog.summary: A playable 3D settlement-building game about growing a community and managing a living world.
catalog.requirement: Explorable 3D world; construction; settlers or autonomous agents; resource gathering and production; logistics; progression or objective; save/load

catalog.title: Voxel Survival Sandbox
catalog.summary: A playable voxel-based sandbox focused on exploration, gathering, crafting, building and survival.
catalog.requirement: Genuine editable 3D voxel world; movement; mining and placement; inventory; crafting; survival or exploration loop; persistent world

catalog.title: 2D Beat-'em-up
catalog.summary: A complete side-scrolling action brawler with responsive combat, enemies and a satisfying progression arc.
catalog.requirement: Playable character; movement and combat; reliable hit detection; enemy behaviours; progression through an encounter or stage; ending or boss; keyboard/touch

catalog.title: 3D Racing Game
catalog.summary: A playable 3D racing experience built around vehicle handling, a designed course and a clear competition or time-trial loop.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D vehicle and course; acceleration/braking/steering; collisions or track boundaries; race or time-trial objective; HUD; restart; best result save

catalog.title: Action Roguelite
catalog.summary: A replayable action game with changing runs, combat, meaningful upgrades and a clear run-ending challenge.
catalog.requirement: Replayable run structure; procedural or varied encounters; responsive movement/combat; distinct enemies; meaningful upgrades; final challenge; run results
